scope: Development study of the optimizer alone on the original eta = 1/32 instance: the v2 recipe (data, calibration, model, initialization bytes, normalization, Adam schedule, compiled packed analytic engine, observer and physical limits) with the L-BFGS phase replaced by a dense self-scaled Broyden (SSBroyden) quasi-Newton method. Motivation (Section 6.11 attribution): the remaining pressure error is an independent component weighted at about one percent of the residual energy, which L-BFGS does not resolve before stalling near a loss of 1.3-1.6e-6 (v5). Seeds 361901/361902 were observed before; no result is a formal claim.

instance.note: the original instance of v1-v5; inputs are data/ unchanged

arms.fresh: the unchanged 4,000 Adam updates from the stored initial parameters, then SSBroyden
arms.continue: SSBroyden from the v5 analytic final checkpoint of the same seed (4,000 Adam updates and 4,800 L-BFGS calls), sha256-verified, with checks against dense parameter AD at the start and of the start loss against the source final loss

training.engine: compiled packed activation with analytic transpose, CUDA Graph replay (as v2 and v5)

optimizer.method: self-scaled Broyden (SSBroyden), dense inverse Hessian in FP64 on the GPU
optimizer.update: Urban, Stefanou and Pons, J. Comput. Phys. 523 (2025) 113656, Eqs. (10), (13)-(23); identical to Kiyani et al., arXiv:2501.16371, Eq. (15) and its definitions; box376.ssbroyden
optimizer.H0: identity (as Kiyani et al.; the update scaling tau adapts it)
optimizer.safeguards: update skipped when y.s <= 1e-12 |y||s|; H reset to I when a direction is not a descent direction or the line search gives no decrease; two consecutive resets end the optimizer phase
optimizer.one_matvec_per_iteration: H y = H g_{k+1} + d_k; H_{k+1} g_{k+1} carried in O(n) and checked against an explicit product at every complete-gradient check

training.maximum_training_seconds_reason: 2 h allocation: measured v6 overheads (about 20 s activation, about 50 s compiler smoke, about 230 s setup including the continue checks), the training guard, about 1,850 s per observation at chunk 512 (estimate 2,000 s) and a 400 s reserve for reader, decision and archive (they took about 25 s in v6); the final observation then starts with about 460 s of margin
training.trainer: box376.potential_train_v7 (potential_train_v2 with the L-BFGS phase replaced and the continue arm)
training.gradient_reference: preserved full native reference at the stored initial parameters (eager, compiled, graph); dense eager parameter AD after a change, at the continue start and every 1,000 iterations

physical.state_observer: native coordinate AD of the trained curl-potential network

physical_observation.observer: box376.potential_physical_eta at eta 1/32, which binds nothing new: the unchanged box376.potential_physical
physical_observation.note: Per lane, final first; an observation starts only if the lane budget and the allocation deadline allow its estimate.

outcomes_in_order.F1_pass: at least one run passes physical acceptance at an observed checkpoint
outcomes_in_order.F2_near_miss: no run passes, and some run's complete final observation exceeds no acceptance limit by more than 1.5 times
outcomes_in_order.F0_incomplete: no pass and no near miss, and some registered run lacks a complete final observation (failed or killed training, observation not run or failed)
outcomes_in_order.F3_fail: no pass and no near miss, with complete final observations of all four runs

follow_up.F1_pass: register a formal fresh-seed time-to-accuracy protocol on the original instance with this optimizer
follow_up.F2_near_miss: no formal claim; a longer optimizer budget would need a new protocol
follow_up.F0_incomplete: no scientific reading; find and repair the cause before a new attempt
follow_up.F3_fail: no formal claim within this 3 h budget (see caveats)

secondary_readouts: fresh runs: first evaluation at or below each loss threshold against the v5 analytic L-BFGS run of the same seed
continue runs: final loss over start loss

post hoc (CPU, tools/c36_pressure_attribution.py on the final states): the pressure fraction of the residual energy and the cosine with the velocity inertia error, i.e. whether the optimizer removed the about-one-percent pressure component
caveats: Amended before any run: the 2 h allocation leaves about 3,300 s (fresh) and 3,950 s (continue) for the optimizer, about 60% of the planned 3 h budget, so roughly 11,000-13,000 iterations.

A dense quasi-Newton update adds at most rank two per iteration; about 20,000 iterations in this window see fewer directions than the 50,692 parameters, so a failure does not exclude SSBroyden at a longer budget. Seconds per iteration are recorded so that a full-length window can be stated.
The continue arm restarts curvature information at a loss near 1e-6, which v4 showed can measure the restart rather than the optimizer; a failed continuation does not by itself reject the optimizer.
The literature networks have 1-3 thousand parameters; this one has 50,692.
decision_rule.implementation: box376.decide_c36_v7 on box376.read_c36_v7; synthetic tests box376.test_decide_c36_v7

execution.allocation: one ACC node, 2 h (QoS acc_interactive), four H100 GPUs; one lane per (arm, seed), all four concurrent
execution.node_count_reason: four single-GPU lanes (two arms x two seeds); the smallest count that runs all four at once
execution.memory: dense inverse Hessian 20.6 GB per lane plus about 11 GB of training state, on 64 GB H100s
execution.start_command: embedded in the batch script; the cluster-side driver box376.run_c36_v7 runs admission, training, observation, reader, decision and archive
execution.storage: work root on project storage with every cache inside the batch directory
execution.qos_reason: the project allocation behind the regular QoS is exhausted; the user instructed the acc_interactive QoS (2026-10-19), whose limit is 2 h on one node

amendments.change: allocation 3 h -> 2 h on QoS acc_interactive; maximum_training_seconds 6,600 -> 4,000; deadline reserve 900 -> 400 s
amendments.reason: the regular QoS is unavailable (allocation exhausted); user instruction to use acc_interactive, whose maximum wall time is 2 h
